ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person, man') keeps Tolstoy's 'he' where the website draft had 'they'. «Должное» (dolzhnoe, 'what one ought to do') is rendered as 'what you consider you must do' rather than the website's 'right', and the italic thought in no. 6 keeps its italics.
